class.name: NetwEntity
class.brief_description: The identity of one networked node, player or server-owned.
class.description:
One networked entity is one root node holding one [NetwEntity]. Nodes under the root read it to learn who the entity is, who controls it, and when it spawns and despawns. [codeblock] NetwEntity.of(node) # walks up to the entity, null when there is none Netw.configure_entity(self) # gets or creates it on a root, in _init [/codeblock] [member controller] and [member authority] are settled before the node enters the tree, so [member is_controlled_locally] and [method Node.is_multiplayer_authority] are already correct in [method Node._enter_tree] and [method Node._ready] on every peer. [codeblock] var entity := NetwEntity.of(hit_node) if entity and entity.is_player: eliminate(entity.peer_id) [/codeblock] [b]Declaring an entity[/b] A root declares itself in [code]_init[/code]. A child marks its own spawn properties in its [code]_init[/code] and connects to the entity in [method Node._ready], once it has a parent to walk up to. [codeblock] # on the root func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.initial_controller = NetwEntity.INITIAL_PLAYER entity.spawned.connect(_on_spawned) Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").on_spawn()
# on a child func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"health").on_spawn()
func _ready() -> void: NetwEntity.of(self).despawning.connect(_on_despawning) [/codeblock] A node placed in a scene by hand sets its own [member name]. A spawned copy receives it with the spawn. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).name = &"ball" [/codeblock] [b]Control and authority[/b] [constant AUTHORITY_SERVER] keeps Godot multiplayer authority on the server while [member controller] steers. [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER] moves Godot authority with control. Properties configured with [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] are server-written in both modes. [member NetwSimulation.claim_on_contact] and [member NetwSimulation.release_on_rest] let a body take control of what it touches and hand it back once it rests. [b]Letting the controller spawn and despawn[/b] Only the server spawns, moves and despawns an entity by default. When [member lifecycle] is [constant LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] the [member controller] may too, and the change shows on its screen at once. The server can refuse it in [signal lifecycle_requested], and the change is then undone on the controller. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).lifecycle = NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER [/codeblock] [b]Simulation[/b] [member simulation] says how the entity's body runs on each peer, [member prediction] how a controller runs it ahead, and [member display] how it is drawn. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.simulation.replicas = NetwSimulation.REPLICAS_ACTIVE entity.prediction.archetype = NetwPrediction.ARCHETYPE_SOLVER_BODY [/codeblock]

method.name: claim_control
method.description: Asks the server to make this peer the [member controller] with [param hold]. The returned [NetwPromise] resolves with this entity once the decision reaches this peer. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED another peer's hold or control_requested refused it ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE transfer does not allow a claim, or it is ┃ TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE on an entity with a state() ┃ property, prediction or a MultiplayerSynchronizer ┖╴ERR_TIMEOUT no decision arrived within one second [/codeblock] Under [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] this peer runs the node before the decision. A refusal restores the controller's latest values. [codeblock] entity.claim_control(NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE) \ .then(func(_held: NetwEntity) -> void: pick_up()) \ .catch_error(func(_code: Error, _detail: String) -> void: shrug()) [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: despawn
method.description:
Frees [member owner] after emitting [signal despawning] and saving its [member persistence]. Entities under it despawn too, unless their [member on_parent_despawn] is [constant PARENT_DESPAWN_DETACH]. [codeblock] entity.despawn()
var opts := NetwDespawnOpts.create(&"killed") opts.flush_save = false entity.despawn(opts) [/codeblock] The server may call it, and so may the [member controller] of a [constant LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] entity.

method.name: of
method.description: The [NetwEntity] of [param node]'s entity root, walking up the parents, or [code]null[/code] when [param node] is under no entity. It works off the tree too. [method Netw.configure_entity] declares a root.

method.name: release_control
method.description: Hands control of this entity to [param successor], which is the server by default. The returned [NetwPromise] resolves with this entity once the decision reaches this peer. The request carries this peer's latest [method NetwPropertyConfig.broadcast] values, and [param successor] starts from them. Values larger than 1024 bytes are not sent, and [param successor] starts from its own copy. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER successor is not a peer id ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer neither controls the entity nor is claiming it ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE successor holds no copy of the entity [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

members.member: The peer whose [NetwAction] spawned this entity, or [code]0[/code].
The tick of the [NetwAction] that spawned this entity, or [code]-1[/code] when no action spawned it.
The [NetwDespawnOpts] of the despawn in progress, readable during [signal despawning], or [code]null[/code].

Who holds Godot multiplayer authority for the root and its children. Set it before tree entry. Later changes are refused. At spawn, a non-server Godot authority on the root selects [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER] if neither [member controller] nor this mode was explicitly assigned.
Whether a peer or the server controls this entity. See [enum ControlKind].

The peer that steers the root, or [code]1[/code] for the server. While [member stage] is [constant STAGE_UNBOUND], a write sets the starting controller. After that, only the server can write it, and [member hold] resets to [constant HOLD_NONE]. See [method claim_control] for a player request.

The player that steers this entity, or [code]null[/code] when the server controls it. It can differ from [member player], since a player can steer a server-owned entity. Writing a player hands the entity to that player, and writing [code]null[/code] hands it to the server. It is how a listen server gives an entity to its own player, because writing [code]1[/code] to [member controller] gives it to the server. [codeblock] car.entity.controller_player = Netw.session(self).local_player [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]
The entity's [NetwDisplay], which configures how the entity is drawn. A single value is smoothed with [NetwInterpolate].
How strongly [member controller] holds this entity. Control the server gives out by itself holds [constant HOLD_NONE].
The entity's [NetwInterest]. Never [code]null[/code], and what is declared on it survives leaving and re-entering the tree.
[code]true[/code] while a [method claim_control] from this peer is waiting for its decision.

[code]true[/code] when a player on this peer controls the entity, or is claiming a [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] entity. An entity the server controls reads [code]false[/code] everywhere, the server included. It does not depend on [member authority].
[code]true[/code] when this entity represents a player, meaning [member peer_id] is not [code]0[/code].

[code]true[/code] when this entity is a multiplayer scene, which [member scene] returns for it and every entity under it. Declared with [method Netw.configure_scene] in [code]_init[/code]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_scene(self).labeled(&"Arena") [/codeblock]

Excludes this root from replication. The root is hidden and its processing is disabled. Set it before tree entry. It cannot be cleared. A root with an empty [member name] and a [member Node.owner] becomes a template automatically.

Who may spawn, move and despawn this entity. Set it in [code]_init[/code] beside [member transfer]. A refused call pushes an error and returns its failure value. [method Node.reparent] cannot be refused, so it warns and the move stays on this peer. During a prediction replay these calls return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] with no error, so a predicted step spawns only on a fresh tick. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.lifecycle = NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER [/codeblock]
The root's [member Node.multiplayer], or [code]null[/code] before the entity spawns.

The name that identifies this entity on every peer, and in saves and logs. A node placed in a scene sets it in [method Object._init], since an entity without one stays inactive. [method Netw.spawn_player] sets it to the player's [member NetwPlayer.username], so a game giving one player several entities sets a distinct name on each.
What happens to the entity when its [member controller] disconnects. An entity spawned for a player still despawns with its [member peer_id].
The root [Node] that holds this entity, or [code]null[/code] once it is freed.

The player peer represented by this root, or [code]0[/code] for an NPC or prop. [method Netw.spawn_player] sets it. The root appears in [member NetwPlayer.entities] and despawns when that peer disconnects.
Loads and saves properties configured with [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted]. See [NetwPersistenceConfig].
The player [member peer_id] represents, or [code]null[/code] for a server-owned entity.
The entity's [NetwPrediction], holding its prediction settings and counters. Never [code]null[/code]. How the entity steps is on [member simulation].

Relative priority when a peer's bandwidth cannot carry every property update. [code]4.0[/code] sends about four times as often as [code]1.0[/code] when both keep changing. Must be greater than zero. [member interest] determines which peers receive updates.
The [RID] that [NetwMultiplayer] methods take for this entity. [codeblock] var state := Netw.of(self).entity_get_state(entity.rid) [/codeblock]

The scene this entity belongs to, which is itself when [member is_scene] is set and otherwise the nearest scene above it. Never [code]null[/code], so read [member NetwScene.is_declared] to know whether one was found. [codeblock] if NetwEntity.of(shooter).scene == NetwEntity.of(target).scene: apply_damage() [/codeblock]
How this entity's body runs on each peer, and which other entities it runs here. Never [code]null[/code].
Where the entity is in its lifecycle.
Whether peers may request control through [method claim_control]. [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] requires [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER]. Set it before tree entry.

signal.name: control_changed
signal.description: Emitted once on each peer when [member controller] changes, after the multiplayer authority has moved under [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER].

signal.name: control_requested
signal.description: Emitted on the server when a peer calls [method claim_control]. Calling [method NetwControlRequest.deny] on [param request] refuses it, whatever the listener order. Not emitted when a [member hold] already refuses the request.

signal.name: despawned
signal.description: Emitted once the entity has been freed, by [method despawn] or by freeing [member owner] directly. [member owner] may already be [code]null[/code], so cleanup that needs the node belongs in [signal despawning].

signal.name: despawning
signal.description: Emitted right before [method despawn] frees the entity, with its [param reason], while [member owner] can still be read. [member active_despawn_opts] is set during it. Freeing the owner directly does not emit it.

signal.name: hidden
signal.description: Emitted on a client that loses its copy of the entity without the entity being despawned, such as a hide under [constant NetwInterestLayer.LEAVE_POLICY_HIDE]. The entity may come back later with the same [member rid]. Neither [signal despawning] nor [signal despawned] is emitted, so anything tied to an entity that may return connects here.

signal.name: lifecycle_refused
signal.description: Emitted on the peer whose spawn, despawn or move of this entity the server refused, before the change is undone. [member NetwLifecycleRequest.reason] is what the server passed to [method NetwLifecycleRequest.deny], or empty when the server refused for another reason.

signal.name: lifecycle_requested
reparented
signal.description: Emitted once after the entity moves to a new parent, by [method Node.reparent], [method Netw.reparent], or [method Node.remove_child] followed by [method Node.add_child]. Read the new parent from [member owner]. [code]_exit_tree[/code] also runs during a move, so teardown that must happen once belongs in [signal despawning] or [signal hidden]. [codeblock] NetwEntity.of(self).reparented.connect(reset_smoothing) [/codeblock]

signal.name: spawned
signal.description: Emitted once after the owner's [method Node._ready] completes.

signal.name: spawning
signal.description: Emitted once after identity, authority and spawn properties are applied. The owner is in the tree, but [method Node._ready] may still be running.

signal.name: stage_changed
signal.description: Emitted synchronously after [member stage] changes, before [signal spawning], [signal despawning] or [signal despawned]. Unchanged values and rejected changes emit nothing. [constant STAGE_LIVE] does not imply readiness. Use [signal spawned] for that. A handler can change [member stage] again before later listeners run, so [param previous] and [param current] identify the reported change.

constants.constant: A player controls the entity, and [member controller_player] names it. On a listen server that player can be the host, at peer [code]1[/code].
The server controls the entity, and [member controller] is [code]1[/code].
The server controls the entity at spawn.
The player in [member peer_id] controls the entity at spawn.
The server holds the multiplayer authority whoever the [member controller] is.
The [member controller] holds the multiplayer authority, and it moves with every change of control.
Every [method claim_control] is refused.
Peers may ask the server for control.

Like [constant TRANSFER_REQUESTABLE], and the asking peer runs the entity before the decision arrives. A refusal puts back the controller's latest values. Not available on an entity with a [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property, prediction, or a [MultiplayerSynchronizer].
Keeps no other peer out.
Another peer's [constant HOLD_EXCLUSIVE] claim takes the entity. Another peer's [constant HOLD_YIELDABLE] claim is refused.
Every other peer's claim is refused. Only the server writing [member controller] moves the entity.
The server takes control when the controller disconnects.
The entity despawns when its controller disconnects.
The entity despawns with the entity above it.
The entity moves up to its despawning parent's own parent, keeping where it stands. A held item drops where its holder stood.
Only the server spawns, moves and despawns the entity. Other peers are refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

The [member controller] may also spawn, move and despawn the entity, and a peer that spawns one becomes its controller. Other peers are refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED]. A predicted entity, an entity spawned for a player, and an entity replicated by a [MultiplayerSynchronizer] or [MultiplayerSpawner] allow only the server, and refuse other peers with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE].
No identity yet, and nothing is sent for it. A node created in code starts here.
A template. See [member is_template].
Identity is set and the node has not entered the tree yet.
In the tree and replicating.
Being despawned. See [member active_despawn_opts].
Inactive but still available to rewind, waiting to be freed.
The owner is gone.
